data.name: Dhimahi
data.gender_notes: Dhimahi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dhimahi comes from the Sanskrit word 'dhima' which means deep meditation or contemplation. This name is associated with spiritual growth and inner wisdom. It is believed that those named Dhimahi have the ability to focus their minds and connect with the divine. The name Dhimahi carries the meaning “Meditation, Contemplation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhimahi usually hope their child will grow to embody meditation, contemplation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Connecting with the divine through deep meditation
data.etymology: Dhimahi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Meditation, Contemplation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhimahi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
